name: Globex open ORB 5 break (18:00–18:05), follow, flat 20:00
why: The first minutes of a session settle the orders queued for the open; a close beyond that range means one side's resting orders are used up and the stops beyond it add fuel. Globex reopen: Asian desks and hedgers. Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_session_cockpit.md).
